name: Andaz Costa Rica Resort at Peninsula Papagayo
positioning: Luxury eco resort (officially Andaz Peninsula Papagayo Resort, Costa Rica) within the private 1,400-acre Peninsula Papagayo in Guanacaste, with three beaches, a beach club, and villas and suites with private plunge pools overlooking Culebra Bay
best_for: Beach lovers who want three beaches and a beach club within a private peninsula
Families or groups who want a villa or penthouse with a private plunge pool and a kitchen
Couples who want a suite with a private pool and an outdoor soaking tub

facts.text: The resort is set within the private 1,400-acre Peninsula Papagayo in Guanacaste, Costa Rica.
The resort offers three beaches and a beach club.
The hotel describes itself as a luxury eco resort in Guanacaste.
Floor-to-ceiling windows and folding glass doors bring the tropical forest into the living space.
Each room has a river stone rain shower that opens out to a bird's nest-inspired balcony with views of Culebra Bay.
Villas and suites offer a deep soaking tub, a plunge pool or both.
The 1 Bedroom Villa has a private plunge pool with views of the resort and Culebra Bay, an open-plan living room and a gourmet kitchen.
Villas come with a dedicated personal VIP concierge service.
The resort has a spa, ONDA Spa & Wellness.
Golf, tennis and pickleball are among the activities the resort lists.
Casa de Playa, set on Nacascolo Beach, brings the flavors of the Greek islands to Papagayo with seafood, grilled meats and fresh vegetables.
At Coffee & Vinyls, guests can select and play a vinyl record of their choice with their specialty coffee.

highlights.text: The resort offers three beaches and a beach club within the private 1,400-acre Peninsula Papagayo.
The 2 Bedroom Penthouse is a three-level hillside perch with panoramic views of the resort and Culebra Bay and a covered rooftop terrace with a private plunge pool.
The 2 Bedroom Papagayo Pool Suite has a private pool and an oversized terrace with an outdoor soaking tub.
Each room has a river stone rain shower that opens out to a bird's nest-inspired balcony with views of Culebra Bay.
Scuba diving and coral gardening are among the activities the resort lists for exploring Papagayo.

considerations.text: The resort is about 35 minutes from Guanacaste (Liberia) International Airport; arriving via San Jose instead requires a connecting flight of about 50 minutes or a drive of about three and a half hours.
The hotel is pet friendly, but pets are not allowed inside the restaurants.
WhataHotel notes the remote peninsula location means longer transfer times.
